body.v: I moved the notes to a new TeamChat page so everyone can edit them. You may need to sign in again to see it.
You wrote on Wednesday: "The notes are final, I will share them after the call."

hotspots.explain: The address really is Jonas's and the thread is real. A hijacked account passes every address check.
Jonas normally shares notes in the shared folder. A new page that needs a fresh sign-in is out of character, and a real address does not prove the real person wrote it.
teamchat-signin.example is not TeamChat's domain. A thief using Jonas's account can send any link.
Quoting your own words fits a real thread, but anyone reading the inbox can copy them.

who.prompt: Who is really writing to you? Look at the address, not just the name.
who.answer: Possibly not Jonas. The address and the thread are real, so his account may have been taken over. Only a call can tell.
choices: Definitely Jonas, since the thread is real
A stranger with a lookalike address
Maybe Jonas, maybe someone using his hijacked account

emotion.prompt: What feeling is this email trying to create?
emotion.answer: Helpfulness: a colleague made things easier for the whole team.
choices: A wish to be helpful and to keep up with the team

ask.prompt: What exactly does it want you to do?
ask.answer: Sign in again through a link, which would give your TeamChat login to whoever controls Jonas's account.
choices: Sign in again through a link

verify.prompt: How can you check through a channel you control?
verify.answer: Do not use the link. Open TeamChat yourself and look for the notes, or call Jonas on the number you already have.
choices: Click the link, because the thread is real
Reply to ask if it is him
Open TeamChat yourself, or call Jonas on a known number

actions.label: Open TeamChat yourself and look for the notes, or call Jonas
actions.consequence: No new page exists. Jonas knows nothing about the email.

actions.label: Click the link and sign in, since the thread is real
actions.consequence: The sign-in page copies your login for whoever controls the account.

actions.label: Reply and ask "Is this really you?"
actions.consequence: Whoever controls the account answers yes. You only asked the impostor.

actions.label: Tell IT or your lead that Jonas's account may be taken over
actions.consequence: Good call. The account can be locked before it hits more colleagues.

attacker_reveal: Jonas's real account, Jonas's real thread, even your own words quoted back... No lookalike address was needed. Only one door was left: ask him another way.
